description: Pass a PropertyFinder search URL and receive structured property listings. All filters already applied in the URL (location, category, sort, page, etc.) are respected.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description:
- Full PropertyFinder search URL
- Must start with `https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/search`
- E.g.: `https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/search?l=50&c=1&t=1&bdr[]=0&bdr[]=1&bdr[]=2&bdr[]=3&btr[]=1&btr[]=2&btr[]=3&fu=0&ob=mr`
- For page 2: `https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/search?l=50&c=1&t=1&bdr[]=0&bdr[]=1&bdr[]=2&bdr[]=3&btr[]=1&btr[]=2&btr[]=3&fu=0&ob=mr&page=2`
